identity.name: Standard Spike
identity.summary: A spear carrying a narrow torn ivory pennant.
identity.description: Costs 2 stamina per activation. Deals 6 physical damage per affordable activation. Warrior only: gains 2 Momentum after an affordable activation.
identity.lore: No name remains on the cloth, only the direction forward.
